dataset.source_split_not_used: test (no answerKey/facts in the public release)

dedup.step1: drop repeated question ids (keep the first occurrence; train rows before validation rows, file order)
dedup.step2: drop repeated normalized (stem + choices) text; key = norm(stem) + ' || ' + ' | '.join(sorted(norm(choice_text))) so that a re-ordered copy of the same question is also a duplicate; keep the first occurrence in the same order
dedup.norm: unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse every whitespace run to one space, strip

split.id_order_before_shuffle: lexicographic sort of the surviving question ids
split.shortfall_rule: if n < 8000: cut fit first, but not below 1500; then cut dev, but not below 800; if still short, stop with an error (no other split changes)
split.leftover_rule: questions beyond the four targets are listed in unused_ids.json and not used
